context: Write an XML document describing the release of the latest Google Pixel phone. The document must contain at least three placeholders, such as [price], and you must not use commas in your response.

trace.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<phone_release>
  <model>Google Pixel Latest</model>
  <launch_date>[date]</launch_date>
  <cost>[price]</cost>
  <storage_options>[storage]</storage_options>
  <description>The new device features advanced AI capabilities and a premium design.</description>
</phone_release>
